response.rationale: I think these are probably the same capability, described at different levels of detail. Both labels describe ticket sales plus payment. A says "Ticket sales, online payment and refunds" and B says "Ticket sales and payment settlement". In code terms, they share the same central class, RinkService (node 21c65604dec116b1). In A it sits in community:1, next to the persistence classes for bookings and payments (BookingRepository and PuckPayClient). In B it is one of only two classes in component:business. So A reads like the full slice, including the classes RinkService uses to store and pay for bookings, and B reads like the business-logic core of that same flow. The differences are small. A mentions refunds and B mentions settlement, and both are part of handling payments. Community:1 also holds classes outside ticketing, such as MemberRepository, TemperatureRepository and HireStockRepository. Those are why my confidence is only moderate.
